key_difference: (D) implements clearLocalData() as a bare d.set(nullptr), which can re-create thread-local storage during shutdown, and leaves the QThreadData::currentThreadData() guard (and the qthread_p.h include) in qcollator.cpp; (B) moves that guard into a new QThreadStorageData::clear(), so clearLocalData() itself is unconditionally safe during shutdown, and drops the wrapper in favour of inheriting from QThreadStorage<GenerationalCollator>.
